x-groups.title: Connection
x-groups.description: The database to read, and the login that reads it.

x-groups.title: Tables
x-groups.description: Which tables and views are streams.

x-groups.title: Change data
x-groups.description: How a stream read with cdc gets its changes.

x-groups.title: Performance
x-groups.description: How much a read takes at a time.

dsn.title: Connection string
dsn.description: A sqlserver:// URL, or an ADO or ODBC connection string, naming the database to read, such as sqlserver://user:password@host:1433?database=shop&encrypt=true. Without encrypt=true or strict, the server's certificate isn't verified.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema whose tables and views are offered as streams.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The tables and views to offer as streams. Empty: every one in the schema.

cdcMethod.title: CDC method

oneOf.title: Change tracking
oneOf.description: Each changed key's current row, a key changed several times between polls arriving once; a delete carries the key alone. Needs change tracking on for the database and the table.

oneOf.title: Change data capture
oneOf.description: Every change with its whole row, from the change tables the capture job fills, which needs SQL Server Agent and change data capture on for the database and the table.

cdcMethod.description: How cdc reads changes: change_tracking, each changed key's current row; or change_data_capture, every change with its whole row, which needs SQL Server Agent. Either way, a table cdc can read replays a superset, which merge makes effectively once.

chunkRows.title: Rows per chunk
chunkRows.description: Rows per query on a table with a primary key, and changes per resume point of a cdc read; each chunk ends at a resume point.

batchBytes.title: Batch size in bytes
batchBytes.description: Approximate bytes of values per Arrow batch.

snapshotChunkRows.title: Rows per snapshot chunk
snapshotChunkRows.description: Rows per chunk of a cdc table's snapshot; each chunk ends at a resume point.

maxConnections.title: Connections
maxConnections.description: The most connections a read holds to read tables in full or incrementally, as many as it has lanes up to this. A cdc read takes one more.
